print_glare.scope: print route only (scan_film=False); global GlareParams defaults, no per-profile overrides upstream
print_glare.domain: per-pixel lognormal(mean=percent, std=roughness*percent), Gaussian blur sigma=blur scan px, /100, added to linear scan RGB after LUT decode and before scanner USM
print_glare.illuminant: achromatic: D50/K75P viewing illuminant is the XYZ->sRGB adaptation white, so glare_amount*[1,1,1] in linear sRGB (|deviation|<2e-4)
print_glare.seed: deterministic per-pixel hash (Filmify seeded convention); upstream draws a fresh field per run
